name: time-field
title: Time field
description: A time you can type: hours and minutes as segments, in 24-hour or 12-hour form, stepping with the arrow keys and compact enough for a table cell.
docs: value and onValueChange speak 24-hour times ("14:30"), with null while the time is incomplete or outside min and max, the same shape as the Time picker, so the two can be swapped. The locale decides the clock, the order of the parts and the separator (en-US writes AM and PM, nl-NL writes 24 hours), and hour12 overrides it either way. Digits move on by themselves (a 7 can only be 07), ArrowUp and ArrowDown step a part and wrap round (the minutes in steps of minuteStep, 15 puts 07 on 15), Backspace clears it, typing a or p sets AM or PM and a tap on the period turns it over (a mouse click only focuses it the first time, and turns it over from the second click on). A part left with one digit is written out in full, so a 2 in the minutes is 02. A pasted time (14:30, 2:30 pm, 1430) fills every part. min and max are 24-hour times; a time outside them is explained with the range written the way the clock is (Pick a time between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM.), and min later than max is a range through midnight. size="sm" and showIcon={false} make it fit a table cell. name adds a hidden input with the 24-hour time, labels renames the parts for another language, and id goes on the first part, so a label's htmlFor focuses the field; name the group with aria-labelledby.
